paragraphs.text: Nived is a caterer and a member of the Renegades on Avishkar .

A dying Yahenni discovered Nived, their friend and caterer, on the streets of Ghirapur . Nived was putting up an art piece depicting the leaking spire, the symbol of the Renegades. Although Yahenni was surprised at this, they instead focused on apologizing to Nived for having canceled their own Penultimate Party.

Before Nived and Yahenni could speak further, a Consulate enforcer charged in, throwing a Pacification Array on Nived for his act of vandalism. The enforcer triggered the array multiple times, shocking Nived into unconsciousness. Even after Nived stopped moving, he kept charging the array, threatening to kill the renegade. Desperate to stop the violence against their friend, Yahenni saw no recourse but to use their draining ability on the enforcer, sapping his life force and extending their life span by twelve days. When the enforcer was dead, Yahenni dragged Nived's unconscious body behind a closed market stall, out of sight from the street, and hurried on.
